info.name: Delivez — Driver (Rider) Registration
info.description:
Partner (driver) registration for the **Delivez Agent** app, and the ops review — in the order they happen.

**Run it top to bottom.** Every request saves what the next one needs (requestId, tokens, applicationId, fileKey…).

1. Choose the **Production** environment and set `riderPhone` (the driver's mobile, 10 digits).
2. *1. Driver sign-in* → **Send OTP**, put the SMS code in `otpCode`, **Verify OTP**. `GET /rider/me` says where the app goes: `REGISTER` = new driver.
3. *2. Registration* → start, then the steps in order (use **Legal & vehicle — company vehicle** instead of the own-vehicle one if Delivez provides the vehicle; **Hyperlocal** only when the Hyperlocal service is chosen).
4. *3. Documents* → for each `docType` (GOV_ID, PHOTO, PAN, BANK_PROOF, DRIVING_LICENCE, + VEHICLE_RC and VEHICLE_INSURANCE for an own vehicle; ADDRESS_PROOF optional): **Presign** → **Upload file** (pick the file in Body → binary) → **Attach**.
5. **Submit**, then **Status** (the app's ApplicationRecord).
6. *4. Ops review* needs an ops login (`adminPhone`): queue → open → start review → verify each file → approve (`module`, `hub`).

Errors: `{ "error": { "code", "message", "details" } }`; `400 VALIDATION_FAILED` puts each field's message in `details.fieldErrors`. Full guide: docs/RIDER_APP_API.md.

⚠ This is production: every request creates or changes real data, and every OTP sends a real SMS.

item.name: 1. Driver sign-in
item.description: OTP login for the Delivez Agent app (app = RIDER).

exec: // Development / test servers only: the code is in the reply. On production it comes by SMS: put it in otpCode.

request.description: Sends a 6-digit code by SMS to {{riderPhone}}. Saves requestId. Resend after retryAfter seconds; max 5 codes an hour.
Put the SMS code in the otpCode variable first. Saves the access and refresh tokens.

exec: const j = pm.response.json(); console.log('next:', j.next); if (j.rider) pm.collectionVariables.set('riderId', j.rider.id); if (j.application) pm.collectionVariables.set('applicationId', j.application.id);

request.description: next = REGISTER (registration) · STATUS (sent, waiting) · HOME (approved: account.module + profile) · RESTRICTED (on hold). Also applicationRecord and workProfile.

exec: const j = pm.response.json(); pm.collectionVariables.set('riderToken', j.accessToken); pm.collectionVariables.set('riderRefreshToken', j.refreshToken);

request.description: Access tokens last 15 min. Returns a NEW pair; the old refresh token stops working.

item.name: 2. Registration
item.description: The registration screens, in the app's order. Dates can be DD/MM/YYYY (as the app sends them) or YYYY-MM-DD.

request.description: Tiers and services, vehicle types, licence types, job types, declarations, training modules, documents. Send `value`, show `label`.
Opens (or returns) the application. Safe to call twice.
Full legal name, date of birth (18+), service pincode, email (optional), ID type and its last 4 characters.
Tier and its services, working days, shift, work preference (FULL_TIME · PART_TIME · PER_ORDER), experience, phone, navigation app, data plan, permissions consent.

body.raw:
{
  "declarations": {
    "VALID_LICENCE": true,
    "VEHICLE_PAPERS": true,
    "NO_CRIMINAL_RECORD": true,
    "TRANSPORT_NORMS": true
  },
  "licenceType": "MCWG",
  "licenceNumber": "KA03 2019 0012345",
  "licenceExpiry": "30/06/2034",
  "vehicleProvider": "OWN_VEHICLE",
  "vehicleCategory": "BIKE",
  "vehicleType": "MOTORCYCLE_SCOOTER",
  "vehicleMakeModel": "Honda Activa 6G",
  "vehicleRegNumber": "KA 03 TT 1234",
  "vehicleOwnership": "OWNED",
  "operationalCondition": "GOOD"
}

request.description: Own vehicle: type (in the category), make & model, registration, ownership, condition; 4 declarations; licence must cover the vehicle.
Use INSTEAD of the own-vehicle request when Delivez provides the vehicle: category only, 3 declarations, no RC / insurance.
Only when services include HYPERLOCAL. A company vehicle can only take job types that fit it.
All 5 declarations.
Operational role (LAST_MILE · HUB_ASSOCIATE) and all 5 training modules.
missing.problems lists what is left, in plain words; canSubmit = true when ready.

item.name: 3. Documents (step 5)
item.description: For each docType: Presign → Upload file → Attach. Set the docType environment variable first.

exec: // size must be a number in the JSON body

request.description: contentType: image/jpeg · image/png · image/webp · application/pdf. size in bytes (≤ 10 MB). Saves uploadUrl and fileKey.

item.name: Upload file (pick it in Body → binary)

request.description: Sends the file bytes to the link from Presign (valid a few minutes). Select the file under Body → binary; its type must match docContentType.
Links the uploaded file. The same type again replaces it.

item.name: 3b. Fix a document (optional)
item.description: Only when a file must be taken off before submitting.

item.name: Submit & status
item.description: Send the application to ops, then follow it.

request.description: 422 APPLICATION_INCOMPLETE: message = first missing item, details = all of them. Locked afterwards until ops send it back.
status: underReview · actionRequired · approved · rejected; message; documentStatuses per document id; assignedHub after approval.

item.name: 4. Ops review (admin)
item.description: Needs an ops login (app = ADMIN) with a role that manages riders: FOUNDER, HEAD_OF_OPS, REGIONAL_HEAD, CITY_OPS or COMPLIANCE.

exec: // Development / test servers only: the code is in the reply. On production it comes by SMS: put it in otpCode.

request.description: Sends a 6-digit code by SMS to {{adminPhone}}. Saves requestId. Resend after retryAfter seconds; max 5 codes an hour.
Put the SMS code in the otpCode variable first. Saves the access and refresh tokens.

exec: const it = pm.response.json().items; if (it.length) { pm.collectionVariables.set('applicationId', it[0].id); pm.collectionVariables.set('riderId', it[0].riderId); }

request.description: Finds this driver by phone (search = name, phone or rider code; leave it empty for everyone). Add status=SUBMITTED · UNDER_REVIEW · CHANGES_REQUESTED · APPROVED · REJECTED to filter. Saves the first result as applicationId.

exec: const j = pm.response.json(); if (j.documents.length) pm.collectionVariables.set('documentId', j.documents[0].id); console.log('suggested module:', j.summary.suggestedModule);

request.description: All answers, summary (tier, services, vehicle, suggestedModule), documents with 15-minute view links, what is missing. Saves the first document as documentId.
Repeat for every required document (set documentId).
The driver sees "Rejected: <reason>".

exec: // No cityId set: leave it out, and the city comes from the driver's pincode.
if (!cityId) { const b = JSON.parse(pm.request.body.raw); delete b.cityId; pm.request.body.raw = JSON.stringify(b, null, 2); }

request.description: Every required document must be verified first. module = the app module (default: from the first service); hub is shown in the app; cityId optional when the pincode is in a Delivez city.
The app shows actionRequired with this message.
Final.
Logs the driver out everywhere; refused while they carry an order.
